lines.text: [thoughtfully] Okay. [pause] I came in ready to be polite, honestly. [laughs softly] And now I'm kind of worried about my own idea.
[excited] The constraint is real, the cost curve bends the right way, and it ships this week. [laughs] I hate that I have no objection.

verdict.summary: Unanimous, and visibly annoyed about it.
verdict.roast: We looked for something to mock and found nothing. Please do not let this go to your head. We will find something next time.
